query_text: Which section in BNSS corresponds to CrPC Section 154 for lodging an FIR?
ground_truth_answer: Section 173 of BNSS 2023 governs Information in Cognizable Cases (FIR), introducing electronic FIRs (formerly Section 154 CrPC).

query_text: What section in BNSS empowers police officers to make an arrest without warrant?
ground_truth_answer: Police arrest without warrant is governed under Section 35 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 41 of CrPC).

query_text: What is the equivalent section for police remand / judicial custody (CrPC 167) in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in 24 hours (remand) is governed by Section 187 of BNSS 2023 (formerly CrPC 167).

query_text: Where is Anticipatory Bail covered in BNSS 2023 compared to CrPC Section 438?
ground_truth_answer: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest (Anticipatory Bail) is under Section 482 of BNSS (CrPC 438).

query_text: Which section in BNSS covers regular bail in non-bailable offences (CrPC 437)?
ground_truth_answer: Bail in non-bailable offences is governed by Section 480 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 437 CrPC).

query_text: What section in BNSS authorizes magistrates to issue prohibitory orders (CrPC 144)?
ground_truth_answer: Power to issue orders in urgent cases of nuisance or apprehended danger is under Section 163 of BNSS (CrPC 144).

query_text: Where is the police final report / charge-sheet filing covered in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Report of police officer on completion of investigation (charge-sheet) is under Section 193 of BNSS (CrPC 173).

query_text: What section in BNSS provides for recording confessions and statements (CrPC 164)?
ground_truth_answer: Recording of confessions and statements by Magistrate is under Section 183 of BNSS (CrPC 164).

query_text: Which section in BNSS governs the inquest report on unnatural death (CrPC 174)?
ground_truth_answer: Police inquiry and report on suicide / unnatural death is governed by Section 194 of BNSS (CrPC 174).

query_text: What section in BNSS covers trial in absentia of proclaimed offenders?
ground_truth_answer: Trial of proclaimed offenders in absentia is introduced under Section 356 of BNSS 2023.

query_text: Where is search of place entered by person sought to be arrested covered in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Search of place entered by person sought to be arrested is under Section 44 of BNSS (CrPC 47).

query_text: What section governs security for keeping peace on conviction in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Security for keeping the peace on conviction is governed by Section 125 of BNSS (CrPC 106).

query_text: Which section covers maintenance of wives, children and parents in BNSS (CrPC 125)?
ground_truth_answer: Order for maintenance of wives, children and parents is under Section 144 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 125 CrPC).

query_text: Where is plea bargaining codified in BNSS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Plea bargaining is covered under Chapter XXI, Sections 289 to 300 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Chapter XXIA CrPC).

query_text: What is the section for summary trial in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Power to try summarily is covered under Section 283 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 260 CrPC).

query_text: Where is compounding of offences covered under BNSS 2023 (CrPC 320)?
ground_truth_answer: Compounding of offences is governed by Section 359 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 320 CrPC).

query_text: What section governs withdrawal from prosecution by Public Prosecutor in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Withdrawal from prosecution is covered under Section 360 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 321 CrPC).

query_text: What section in BNSS authorizes forensic investigation mandates at crime scenes?
ground_truth_answer: Mandatory visit of forensic experts to crime scenes for offences punishable with 7+ years is under Section 176(3) BNSS.

query_text: Where is audio-video recording of search and seizure mandated in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Mandatory videography and electronic recording of search and seizure is under Section 105 of BNSS 2023.

query_text: What section governs appeals against conviction in BNSS (CrPC 374)?
ground_truth_answer: Appeals from convictions are governed under Section 415 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 374 CrPC).

query_text: Where is appeal against acquittal covered in BNSS (CrPC 378)?
ground_truth_answer: Appeal in case of acquittal is covered under Section 419 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 378 CrPC).

query_text: What section provides for High Court inherent powers (CrPC 482) in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Saving of inherent powers of High Court is under Section 528 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 482 CrPC).

query_text: Where is execution of death sentence covered in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Execution of order of death sentence is governed under Section 453 of BNSS 2023.

query_text: What section governs mercy petitions to the Governor or President in BNSS?
ground_truth_answer: Procedure and timelines for mercy petitions in death sentences are codified under Section 472 of BNSS 2023.

query_text: What section covers period of detention undergone by accused to be set off against sentence (CrPC 428)?
ground_truth_answer: Set off of period of detention is under Section 468 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 428 CrPC).

query_text: How does BNSS Section 187 split police custody across the first 40 or 60 days compared to CrPC 167?
ground_truth_answer: Under Section 187 of BNSS 2023 police custody of 15 days can be taken in parts across the first 40 or 60 days.

query_text: Under what provision in BNSS is trial through audio-video electronic means (virtual witness examination) permitted?
ground_truth_answer: Electronic virtual witness examination and audio-video trials are authorized under Section 530 of BNSS 2023.

query_text: What section in BNSS sets a 3-day timeline for physical signature on an electronic e-FIR?
ground_truth_answer: Section 173(1) of BNSS 2023 requires that electronic information (e-FIR) be signed within three days.

query_text: How is attachment and forfeiture of property of proclaimed offenders handled in BNSS (CrPC 83)?
ground_truth_answer: Attachment of property of person absconding is under Section 86 of BNSS 2023 (formerly Section 83 CrPC).

query_text: What is the strict 60-day limitation period for filing mercy petitions under BNSS Section 472?
ground_truth_answer: Section 472 of BNSS 2023 introduces strict 60-day limitation periods for convicts to file mercy petitions.
